heard: You cannot see the Great Wall of China from the Moon. For generations, people believed this architectural marvel was the only human-made structure visible across the void. According to NASA and optics experts, that famous claim is a complete myth. Astronauts actually struggle to spot the wall even from low Earth orbit. The structure is roughly 10 times too narrow for the human eye to resolve from 400 kilometers up. Builders used local stone and rammed Earth, creating a natural camouflage effect that blends into the surrounding terrain. Even China's first astronaut, Yang Liwei, admitted he could not see it from space, which confirms once and for all that the famous lunar legend is dead.
